items.title: ambient closure state should no longer rely on changelog memory alone
items.prior_state: objects could stop being live only by diff inference across open questions, queues, ledgers, quarantine, and changelog prose
items.closure_reason: Several unrelated datacubes keep explicit latest decisions, closure states, or deprecations, and DelayBasin needed one compact closure packet so resolved or superseded objects do not disappear into chronology.
items.reopen_trigger: Retire or replace this ratchet if later passes show existing open-question, followthrough, assumption, and foreign-pressure surfaces already preserve closure honestly without a separate witness, or promote a smaller cross-lane controller if multi-object supersession cases become common.

items.title: retrospective-write law no longer lives only in prose and checker text
items.prior_state: retrospective-write law existed in canon and method notes but cooled-candidate state still disappeared into prose unless remembered
items.closure_reason: Repeated cross-datacube pressure for durable candidate/hold/review state justified operationalizing cooled admission with one tiny queue and receipt witness.
items.reopen_trigger: Retire or replace this surface if later passes show the queue adds no recoverable truth beyond prose, or promote a smaller cross-lane controller if multiple cooled candidates or adjudication families become common.

items.title: reasoning-firebreak law no longer lives only in prose and promptcraft
items.prior_state: reasoning-firebreak law existed in canon, runbook, and promptcraft, but a shipped revision could still rely on that split without any durable witness saying what public extract counted and what larger trace stayed withheld
items.closure_reason: Repeated cross-datacube pressure for stable public surfaces and explicit private or privileged trace boundaries justified operationalizing reasoning-firebreak law with one tiny ledger and receipt witness.
items.reopen_trigger: Retire or replace this surface if later passes show the ledger adds no recoverable truth beyond receipt prose, or promote a smaller cross-lane controller if multiple trace-role cases become common.
